title: AdjudicationRecord
description: The record by which a human reviewer or a deterministic policy/authority produces the VERIFIED label for a decision step — turning a pile of LLM/consensus proposals into trustworthy training/eval data. This is the truth-producing event the WorkflowTrace.final_decision and ConsensusRun.final_label point at: adjudicated_by ∈ {human_reviewer, deterministic_policy, authority_ranking} (the existing Baltor reconciliation/policy authorities, NOT a new authority). It REQUIRES source_handles and a receipt_id (verified label = source-grounded + receipt-backed) and records which proposals it accepted vs held out (e.g. FAQ-30 held out). A label adjudicated_by='consensus' is invalid by enum. Deterministic when adjudicated_at is injected.

subject_artifact_ids.description: the artifacts whose decision was adjudicated

adjudicated_by.description: WHO produced the verified label; never 'consensus'/'llm' — those are proposals, not adjudicators

reviewer_id.description: accountable signer when adjudicated_by=human_reviewer (no PII; an opaque id)

policy_id.description: the deterministic policy/authority rule applied when adjudicated_by != human_reviewer (e.g. existing reconciliation authority ranking)

verified_label.description: the trustworthy outcome (e.g. 'winner=reg-e-10day, faq-30 held out'); this is the label the factory may distill toward

accepted_proposal_ids.description: llm_trace_id / consensus_run_id proposals this adjudication accepted as consistent with the verified label

held_out_proposal_ids.description: proposals held out (e.g. the FAQ-30 answer) — kept, never deleted (lossless), but not served

source_handles.description: ctx:// handles grounding the verified label; REQUIRED — an ungrounded adjudication is not a verified label

receipt_id.description: the verification/adjudication receipt warranting this label; REQUIRED — verified = receipt-backed

reversed.description: true if this adjudication was later overturned; a reversed adjudication is never mined as truth
